name: Bakonya (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bakonya (a green shield with a yellow gateway and ears of grain, between a wreath of grain) above a scroll inscribed Bakonya.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bakonya arms with wreath and scroll
